description: Build the new high-quality collapsible Sidebar component and its CSS. Depends on FEAT-001 (SidebarContext and AppLayout must already exist). Replace the existing src/components/Sidebar.jsx with the full-featured sidebar: grouped navigation, logo area, collapse button, bottom-pinned settings, smooth CSS transition, and responsive overlay/drawer below 768px. Create src/components/sidebar.css for all sidebar-specific styles.
steps: Create src/components/sidebar.css. Define all sidebar CSS using classes (no inline styles in the component). Key classes and rules: .sidebar { position: relative; width: var(--sidebar-w-expanded); min-width: var(--sidebar-w-expanded); height: 100vh; background: var(--surface); border-right: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: width 200ms ease, min-width 200ms ease; overflow: hidden; z-index: 10; flex-shrink: 0; }. .sidebar.collapsed { width: var(--sidebar-w-collapsed); min-width: var(--sidebar-w-collapsed); }. .sidebar-logo { height: var(--topbar-h); display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0; gap: 10px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; }. .sidebar-logo-mark { width: 28px; height: 28px; background: var(--nvidia); border-radius: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }. .sidebar-logo-text { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); letter-spacing: 0.02em; opacity: 1; transition: opacity 150ms ease; }. .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-logo-text { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; width: 0; }. .sidebar-nav { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; padding: 8px 0; }. .sidebar-group { margin-bottom: 4px; }. .sidebar-group-label { padding: 12px 16px 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-3); text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; opacity: 1; transition: opacity 150ms ease, height 150ms ease; }. .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-group-label { opacity: 0; height: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; }. .sidebar-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; height: 40px; color: var(--text-3); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; margin: 1px 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; }. .sidebar-item:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-2); }. .sidebar-item.active { color: var(--nvidia); background: var(--nvidia-glow); }. .sidebar-item-indicator { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 3px; height: 20px; background: var(--nvidia); border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms ease; }. .sidebar-item.active .sidebar-item-indicator { opacity: 1; }. .sidebar-item-icon { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; }. .sidebar-item-label { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; opacity: 1; transition: opacity 150ms ease; }. .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-item { justify-content: center; padding: 0; margin: 1px 8px; }. .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-item-label { opacity: 0; width: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; }. .sidebar-bottom { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 8px 0; flex-shrink: 0; }. .sidebar-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 6px 10px; }. .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-toggle { justify-content: center; }. .sidebar-toggle-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-3); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, background 150ms, border-color 150ms; flex-shrink: 0; }. .sidebar-toggle-btn:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-2); border-color: var(--border-2); }. @media (max-width: 767px) { .sidebar { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 100vh; z-index: 200; transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform 200ms ease, width 200ms ease; width: var(--sidebar-w-expanded) !important; min-width: var(--sidebar-w-expanded) !important; } .sidebar.mobile-open { transform: translateX(0); } .sidebar-overlay { display: block; } }. .sidebar-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 199; }. .sidebar-tooltip { position: absolute; left: calc(var(--sidebar-w-collapsed) + 8px); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text); font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid var(--border-2); white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; z-index: 300; transition: opacity 100ms ease; }. .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-item:hover .sidebar-tooltip { opacity: 1; }

Rewrite src/components/Sidebar.jsx completely. Import useSidebar from ../context/SidebarContext. Import NavLink from react-router-dom. Import ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, LayoutDashboard, FolderTree, FileText, Bot, Zap, Code2, GitPullRequest, BarChart3, Settings, LogOut from lucide-react. Import ./sidebar.css. Define NAV_GROUPS array: [ { label: 'WORKSPACE', items: [ { to: '/dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard, label: 'Workspace Hub' }, { to: '/files', icon: FolderTree, label: 'Codebase' } ] }, { label: 'INTELLIGENCE', items: [ { to: '/requirements', icon: FileText, label: 'Requirements' }, { to: '/agents', icon: Bot, label: 'Agents' }, { to: '/impact-analysis', icon: Zap, label: 'Impact Analysis' } ] }, { label: 'REVIEW & DELIVERY', items: [ { to: '/code-review', icon: Code2, label: 'Code Review' }, { to: '/pr-generator', icon: GitPullRequest, label: 'PR Generator' } ] }, { label: 'INSIGHTS', items: [ { to: '/analytics', icon: BarChart3, label: 'Analytics' } ] } ]. Also define BOTTOM_ITEMS: [ { to: '/settings', icon: Settings, label: 'Settings' } ]. The component reads { isExpanded, toggle } from useSidebar(). Uses useAuth() for { user, logout }. Uses useNavigate() for logout redirect. Renders: (1) logo area with .sidebar-logo, logo mark div, and .sidebar-logo-text showing 'Impact' + green 'IQ'. (2) nav area .sidebar-nav with NAV_GROUPS — for each group render a .sidebar-group with .sidebar-group-label and each item as NavLink with className={({ isActive }) => 'sidebar-item' + (isActive ? ' active' : '')}. Each item contains: .sidebar-item-indicator div, .sidebar-item-icon span with <Icon size={16}/>, .sidebar-item-label span with the label, and a .sidebar-tooltip span with the label (for collapsed tooltip). (3) .sidebar-bottom section: BOTTOM_ITEMS rendered the same way, then a logout button using .sidebar-item class with LogOut icon and 'Sign Out' label, then .sidebar-toggle div with a button that renders <ChevronLeft size={16} /> when expanded and <ChevronRight size={16} /> when collapsed. Sidebar root className: 'sidebar' + (isExpanded ? '' : ' collapsed'). Add isMobileOpen state (default false) and mobileToggle handler for <=767px. Render .sidebar-overlay div (onClick closes mobile) when isMobileOpen.

Modify src/components/AppLayout.jsx. Add a hamburger/menu button to Topbar area for mobile: when screen is <=767px show a menu icon in the Topbar that calls a toggleMobile function from context. Since SidebarContext owns the state, add isMobileOpen and toggleMobile to SidebarContext (alongside isExpanded/toggle). Update SidebarContext.jsx to also expose { isMobileOpen, toggleMobile } with isMobileOpen defaulting to false and toggleMobile flipping it. In Sidebar.jsx, apply 'mobile-open' class when isMobileOpen is true. In AppLayout.jsx, pass a menu-toggle button into Topbar via a prop or render it directly in the app-main header area above Topbar — simplest: add a .mobile-menu-btn button (display:none on desktop, display:flex on mobile) directly in AppLayout before Topbar. Style it with a small inline style or add a class to index.css.

Add responsive CSS to index.css for the app-main area at breakpoint 767px: .app-main should not shift width (sidebar is overlay in mobile mode, not a flex sibling). Add: @media (max-width: 767px) { .app-shell { overflow: visible; } .app-main { width: 100%; } .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex !important; } }. Also add .mobile-menu-btn { display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-2); cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; } to the APP SHELL section of index.css.

Verify the existing Topbar.jsx does not need changes — it already has height:48px and position:sticky. No changes needed there. Remove the logout button from the old Sidebar since logout is now in Topbar's user-dropdown — but keep it in the new Sidebar's bottom section as a secondary action (the user-dropdown in Topbar still has it too; duplication is acceptable). Actually: per the design spec the bottom section should include a logout action — keep it in the new sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors
sidebar.css exists at src/components/sidebar.css and is imported by Sidebar.jsx
Sidebar has a collapse/expand toggle button
When expanded, sidebar is 248px wide and shows icons + labels + group headings
When collapsed, sidebar is 64px wide and shows icons only; group headings are hidden; labels are hidden
Active route item has NVIDIA green color and left indicator bar
No page content is hidden under the sidebar (flex layout ensures main content takes remaining width)
Settings is in the bottom-pinned section
Below 768px sidebar is an overlay/drawer, not a permanent flex child
No purple, pink, excessive cyan, or gradient in sidebar styles

Sidebar.jsx completely rewritten — imports useSidebar (isExpanded, toggle, isMobileOpen, toggleMobile), useAuth (logout), NavLink, useNavigate, lucide-react icons; defines NAV_GROUPS (4 groups, 8 routes) + BOTTOM_ITEMS (/settings); renders logo area, scrollable nav, bottom section with settings+logout+toggle; sidebarClass applies 'collapsed' and 'mobile-open' modifier classes. 3.
